welcome:
Welcome to the Text File Merger Tool.
This is a personal practice project.
It allows you to combine several text files such as .py, .cpp, .c, .json into a single .txt file, for convenient communication with AI.
Available commands: <path>, list, remove <index|path>, clear, merge, help, exit/quit
exit: Are you sure you want to exit?
cometopathinput: Entering path input mode (enter 1 or back to return).
help_text:
Available commands:
  <path>          Add file
  list            View list
  remove <index|path>  Remove file
  clear           Clear list
  merge           Execute merge
  help            Show this help
  exit/quit       Exit
error.language.empty: Language code or locales directory cannot be empty.
